items.title: Lifted State Policy Optimization: Internalizing Self-Correction through Transition Geometry
items.summary_1line: Preference optimization ranks final answers and trajectory RL maximizes aggregate returns, yet neither credits the local change that turns a flawed reasoning state into a better one. We introduce Lifted State Policy O...
items.editor_note: Introduces Lifted State Policy Optimization, crediting the local change from a flawed reasoning state to a better one.

items.title: ReflectPO: Reflection-Guided Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

items.editor_note: Extends policy optimization with reflection guidance for long-horizon, tool-using LLM agents.

items.title: SOPO: Socratic Guided Policy Optimization for Span-Level Hallucination Detection
items.summary_1line: Large Language Models (LLMs) have gained widespread adoption in various natural language processing tasks, but suffer from hallucination issues where they generate unfaithful or inconsistent content. While Reinforceme...
items.editor_note: Uses Socratic guided policy optimization to detect hallucinated spans rather than whole answers.

editorial.tldr: On Oct 14 a paper proposed Lifted State Policy Optimization to credit the local change that turns a flawed reasoning state into a better one. On Oct 22 ReflectPO applied reflection-guided policy optimization to long-horizon LLM agents.
editorial.whats_new: SOPO (Oct 23) applies Socratic guided policy optimization to span-level hallucination detection in LLM output.
editorial.why_it_matters: Three arXiv papers in ten days tailor policy optimization to self-correction, agent horizons and hallucination detection; all are preprints, so treat them as research signals, not production tooling.
editorial.take_for_builders: Treat these as preprints: wait for released code and independent replication before changing any training or eval pipeline.

beats.headline: Lifted State Policy Optimization targets self-correction
ReflectPO brings reflection-guided optimization to long-horizon agents
SOPO aims policy optimization at span-level hallucination detection

open_questions: Do any of these three methods publish code or reproducible results on public benchmarks?
